name: Prof. (Dr.) Karamjeet Singh
paragraphs: It is with deep humility, and a sense of academic responsibility that I extend a warm welcome to all visitors to the official website of Guru Nanak Dev University. Rooted in the universal philosophy of Guru Nanak Dev Ji and inspired by the ideals of inclusivity, service, and enlightenment, GNDU stands as a beacon of higher learning dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge, intellectual inquiry, ethical leadership, and social transformation. Over the decades, the University has evolved into a vibrant academic ecosystem that harmoniously integrates tradition with innovation, local relevance with global perspectives, and academic rigour with humanistic values. Our mission is not merely to impart education, but to nurture enlightened minds, compassionate hearts, and responsible global citizens capable of addressing the complex challenges of the contemporary world.

In alignment with emerging global trends and national priorities, GNDU has established pioneering academic and research initiatives aimed at preparing students for the future knowledge economy. The University has inaugurated the “Surjit Patar Centre for Ethical AI” to advance education and research in ethical artificial intelligence and launched a cutting-edge “5G Use Case Lab” for next-generation communication technologies. Further strengthening its community outreach, GNDU has also launched GNDU RAABTA 89.6 FM, a community radio station dedicated to education, awareness, social inclusion, and public discourse. These initiatives exemplify our commitment to integrating technology, ethics, and community engagement in meaningful ways.

Responding proactively to evolving industry demands and national skill development goals, GNDU has introduced AI-based, job-oriented courses and advanced skill development programmes through its Department of Lifelong Learning. The Golden Jubilee Centre for Entrepreneurship and Innovation (GJCEI), established under RUSA 2.0, serves as a vibrant incubator for innovation and entrepreneurship, currently supporting 14 startups. The University has showcased its sustainable technological solutions at MACHMA EXPO 2025, Chandigarh, and established a Food Processing Unit under RUSA 2.0. Furthermore, the Centre for Agriculture Research and Innovation (CARI) is spearheading pioneering research on high-value crops such as low-chill apples, bananas, saffron, and elite varieties of sweet potatoes enriched with beta-carotene and anthocyanin, contributing significantly to agricultural sustainability, rural development, and food security.

GNDU is distinguished by its state-of-the-art infrastructure, encompassing modern classrooms, advanced laboratories, world-class research facilities, comprehensive libraries, extensive sports complexes, and comfortable hostels. The University’s verdant, eco-friendly, and digitally enabled campus provides a stimulating environment that fosters intellectual curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and holistic personal development. With a forward-looking vision, GNDU has embraced digital transformation across administrative and academic processes. Its Credit-Based Evaluation System and dynamic Placement Cell ensure academic continuity and professional readiness, with over 80% of students securing placements in leading multinational companies, reflecting the University’s strong industry linkages and career-focused academic framework.

As we move forward in an era defined by rapid technological change, environmental challenges, and global interconnectedness, Guru Nanak Dev University remains steadfast in its resolve to advance knowledge, promote innovation, uphold ethical values, and contribute meaningfully to national development and global progress. We are committed to creating a transformative educational experience that empowers students to become visionary leaders, responsible citizens, and compassionate human beings. I warmly invite students, scholars, researchers, educators, alumni, and global partners to engage with GNDU’s vibrant academic community and join us in shaping a future anchored in wisdom, inclusivity, sustainability, and excellence.
